You see Lee'Delle.
  • Ask me if you need help!
  • Buy and sell everything you want here!
  • No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
  • Special offers for premium customers!

Location

Rookgaard's premium west side

Notes

Lee'Delle runs a shop on the premium side of Rookgaard, if your character is premium she gives a discount if you buy her items. She wishes she could be surrounded by her favorite Honey Flowers, which are semi-rare on Rookgaard.
To buy a football you must say football because it doesn't appear in the Trade window.
Next to Lee'Delle, there are blackboards on which is written the following:

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Lee'Delle.

Player: hi
Lee'Delle: Nice to see you,
Player! Ask me for a trade if you like to see my exclusive offers.
Player: help
Lee'Delle: How can I help you? Would you like to trade with me? I can also give you general hints. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
Player: stuff or wares or offer or buy
Lee'Delle: Just ask me for a trade to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell footballs.
Player: weapon
Lee'Delle: You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a trade. Don't be shy!
Player: armor or shield
Lee'Delle: You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a trade. Don't be shy!
Player: equipment
Lee'Delle: Well, very important equipment would be a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark dungeon.
Player: backpack or rope or shovel or torch
Lee'Delle: You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a trade. Don't be shy!
Player: job
Lee'Delle: I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a trade.
Player: name
Lee'Delle: My name is Lee'Delle.
Player: time
Lee'Delle: It's about .
Player: Tibia
Lee'Delle: You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
Player: sell
Lee'Delle: Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
Player: mission or quest
Lee'Delle: I really love flowers. My favourites are honey flowers. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
Player: honey flower or honeyflower
Lee'Delle: Honey flowers are my favourites <sigh>.
Player: honey flower or honeyflower (while carrying a honey flower)
Lee'Delle: Oh, thank you so much! Please take this piece of armor as reward.
Player: dungeon
Lee'Delle: Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough torches and a rope or you might get lost.
Player: monster
Lee'Delle: Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the sewers under the village of Rookgaard.
Player: sewer
Lee'Delle: There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
Player: Rookgaard
Lee'Delle: Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the mainland - so much to explore!
Player: mainland
Lee'Delle: Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the oracle.
Player: oracle
Lee'Delle: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of Tibia.
Player: academy
Lee'Delle: In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
Player: Seymour
Lee'Delle: Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has a lot of important information about Tibia.
Player: academy
Lee'Delle: In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
Player: information
Lee'Delle: What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as equipment, monsters or Rookgaard in general.
Player: Thais
Lee'Delle: Thais is the capital of the Thaian empire. Also, the island of Rookgaard belongs to it.
Player: Dallheim
Lee'Delle: He is a great warrior and our protector.
Player: bye
Lee'Delle: Bye, bye, Player.
